cover.headline: 15 stories in 5 minutes. Brent tops $113, Russia hits Kyiv, Brazil is tied.

stories.head: Russia hits Kyiv after Witkoff meets Putin
body: Overnight strikes killed at least four people in Kyiv and injured dozens, including four children. Two more died in a market in Lozova.
Putin says talks must cover security guarantees for Russia and calls eastern Ukraine historically Russian. A Trump, Putin and Xi meeting may be added to the APEC summit on Nov. 18 to 19.

stories.head: Gulf states brace for a return to war
body: Iran's Guard threatens US bases over Hormuz tanker routes. The US ordered non-essential staff out of Saudi Arabia, and the New York Times says strikes are planned after Nov. 3.
A Houthi strike on Dammam airport killed two people. The Houthi claims on Riyadh and Yanbu are unverified.

stories.head: AI sell-off hits stocks as oil tops $113
body: The S&P 500 fell 1.2%, its worst day since July. Nvidia lost 4.4%, Meta 7%. Brent settled at $113.17, a high since May.
UK inflation hit 3.5%, with fuel up 30%. France pays about 5.07% on 10-year debt, against 3.34% for Germany.

stories.head: Brazil tied, Albania and France in turmoil
body: Brazil: Datafolha has Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro level at 50% before Sunday's runoff.
Albania: lawmakers scuffled as student protests entered a tenth day. France: curfew and protest bans, with a rally planned this weekend and strikes on Nov. 5.
stories.sources: Sources: ANSA, Al Jazeera, Euronews, SBS

stories.head: Quake, Ebola, tariffs and a Sakharov Prize
body: Tibet: a magnitude 7 quake killed at least 16. Nigeria: first Ebola case of the Congo strain. Yemen: nearly 260,000 displaced in Taiz.
Canada: $6.2bn for steel and autos against US tariffs. North Korea: loudspeakers return. Haiti: El Salvador hunts kidnappers. EU: ICC wins the Sakharov Prize.
